mapper.insert: INSERT INTO db_table_version (table_doc_id, batch_id, system_id, database_id, table_name, change_type, table_comment, column_count, columns_json, indexes_json, source_ddl, diff_summary, created_by) VALUES (#{tableDocId}, #{batchId}, #{systemId}, #{databaseId}, #{tableName}, #{changeType}, #{tableComment}, #{columnCount}, #{columnsJson}, #{indexesJson}, #{sourceDdl}, #{diffSummary}, #{createdBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, table_doc_id, batch_id, system_id, database_id, table_name, change_type, table_comment, column_count, diff_summary, created_by, create_time FROM db_table_version WHERE table_doc_id = #{tableDocId} ORDER BY id DESC
SELECT * FROM db_table_version WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(1) FROM db_table_version WHERE batch_id = #{batchId}

SELECT id, table_doc_id, batch_id, system_id, database_id, table_name, change_type, table_comment, column_count, diff_summary, created_by, create_time FROM db_table_version WHERE batch_id = #{batchId} ORDER BY change_type ASC, table_name ASC
